subject.title: fix(infra): bound stalled provider JSON/text/binary response reads with default chunk timeout

question: Should all existing provider JSON/text helper callers inherit the new 30-second idle default and all error-body callers inherit 10 seconds, or should timeout budgets remain opt-in or owner-specific?
rationale: These exported helpers have a broad existing call surface with different latency budgets, so choosing unconditional defaults changes upgrade behavior and cannot be settled by type safety or the focused tests alone.

options.title: Approve audited global defaults
options.body: Keep the 30-second and 10-second defaults after auditing representative callers and adding coverage for slow-but-valid responses that must remain supported.

options.title: Use owner-specific budgets
options.body: Keep the new options but apply explicit idle budgets only at provider paths whose latency contracts justify them.

options.title: Keep timeouts opt-in
options.body: Expose the timeout hooks without changing existing callers until each owner adopts an appropriate budget.

recommendation.title: Approve audited global defaults
recommendation.body: Keep the 30-second and 10-second defaults after auditing representative callers and adding coverage for slow-but-valid responses that must remain supported.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent provider response-bound work is centered on the affected helper surface and its caller contract.
